title: Salesforce Global Outage
summary: Salesforce experienced a global outage affecting its cloud-based CRM platform, with users reporting inability to access services. This represents a significant disruption for enterprise customers relying on Salesforce for sales, service, and marketing operations.
problem_solved: This is an incident report rather than a problem-solving content—documenting a service disruption rather than solving a technical challenge.
why_valuable: Provides visibility into major enterprise cloud outages and serves as a case study for understanding the impact of SaaS reliability on business operations.
